instruction:
Two Storey Classroom Retrofit IFC And Revit Room Schedule CSV

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a two-storey classroom layout, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a Revit room area schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 5 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, and 2 IfcStair entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token classroom at least 4 times and support at least once.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit room schedule export with exactly the headers Room Name,Area in that order and exactly 5 non-empty data rows.
8. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains these exact room name and area rows: Classroom 1=26.0, Classroom 2=26.0, Classroom 3=26.0, Classroom 4=26.0, and Support Room=36.0.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
